en-US.description: Interactive AI agent and terminal UI toolkit in your terminal.
en-US.longDescription:
Raxol CLI is a self-contained interactive AI coding agent for the terminal, built on the Raxol terminal UI toolkit for Elixir. The standalone binary needs no Erlang or Elixir installation.
It runs agent sessions with Model Context Protocol (MCP) support and serves agents over the Agent Client Protocol (ACP) on stdio for editors that spawn an agent themselves, such as Zed and JetBrains IDEs.
en-US.name: Raxol
en-US.releaseNotes:
What's Changed
- Remove npm publish token fallback by @DROOdotFOO in https://github.com/DROOdotFOO/raxol/pull/1002
- Harden release publication paths by @DROOdotFOO in https://github.com/DROOdotFOO/raxol/pull/1003
- Accept exact CLI release versions by @DROOdotFOO in https://github.com/DROOdotFOO/raxol/pull/1004

zh-CN.description: 终端中的交互式 AI 智能体和终端 UI 工具包。
zh-CN.longDescription:
Raxol CLI 是一个面向终端的自包含交互式 AI 编程智能体，基于 Elixir 的 Raxol 终端 UI 工具包构建。该独立二进制文件无需安装 Erlang 或 Elixir。
它支持带模型上下文协议（MCP）的智能体会话，并可通过 stdio 以智能体客户端协议（ACP）为 Zed、JetBrains IDE 等自行拉起智能体的编辑器提供智能体服务。
